audit: V1-A-R Area A: Accessibility Semantics Calibration

sc_1_4_3_normal_text.scope: Body text and text below 18pt (or 14pt bold)

sc_1_4_3_large_text.scope: Text at or above 18pt regular or 14pt bold

sc_1_4_11_non_text_graphics.scope: Active user interface components and graphical objects

complianceCertificationSemantics.sovereignty: Human operator direction is sovereign product authority for runtime trade-offs
complianceCertificationSemantics.certificationBoundary: Human direction does NOT constitute compliance certification
complianceCertificationSemantics.rationale: Automated checks test specific bounded heuristics; full legal/regulatory compliance requires comprehensive multi-modal human and assistive-tech audits

ruleCalibrations.calibratedRatio: 4.5:1 normal text, 3:1 large text (18pt+ / 14pt bold), 3:1 non-text UI graphics (WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.3 / 1.4.11)

ruleCalibrations.applicableThreshold: 44x44px Gravitas Policy (WCAG AA floor is 24x24px per SC 2.5.8; 44x44px is WCAG AAA per SC 2.5.5)
